applicabilityBasis.summary: USDVB is described as a one-for-one representation of a bank deposit with VersaBank USA, not a nonbank-issued payment stablecoin. Explicit deposit-token classification prevents the pilot from being mistaken for GENIUS payment-stablecoin authorization.

genius.notes: The U.S. bank deposit-token pilot is outside the tracked GENIUS payment-stablecoin authorization posture. The August 2025 release says OCC non-objection will be sought before commercialization. The September 2026 filing names the U.S. national-bank subsidiary and still seeks regulatory confirmation of federal deposit-insurance eligibility and the legal ability to pay interest. A bank charter and the VersaVault SOC2 system audit are not token-specific reserve assurance, holder insurance confirmation or GENIUS PPSI approval.

references.label: GENIUS Act: deposits including DLT-recorded deposits excluded
